ob_disc_body:
Sufra helps you plan meals and daily life on dialysis.
It does not replace your nephrologist, renal dietitian or dialysis team. It does not diagnose, and it does not change your treatment. Your care team's advice always comes first.
Food values in Sufra are estimates.
If you feel unwell, contact your dialysis center or emergency services straight away.
ob_country_hint: This helps Sufra use the right guidance and food names.
ob_type_title: What type of dialysis do you have?
type_hd_hint: Using a machine, usually at a center
type_pd_hint: Through the belly, usually at home
ob_sched_hint: Tap the days you usually have dialysis.
ob_cuis_hint: Pick as many as you like. Sufra will suggest meals from these.
ob_diet_hint: Tap any that apply to you.
ob_diet_fast_hint: Sufra will adapt meal ideas for your fasting days. Fasting on dialysis needs planning, so please talk to your care team before you fast.
ob_targets_hint: Only enter numbers your nephrologist or renal dietitian gave you. Leave any box empty if you are not sure yet.
ob_done_body: You can change any answer later in Settings.
fluid_over: {over} {unit} past today's limit. Take it gently for the rest of the day.
fluid_nolimit: No fluid limit saved yet. Ask your care team, then add it in Settings.
log_soon: One-tap drink logging arrives in the next update.
next_none: Add your dialysis days in Settings to see your next session.
meal_soon: Meal ideas from the foods you love will appear here soon.
unwell_urgent: Chest pain, severe breathlessness or sudden swelling: call your local emergency number now.
unwell_missed: Missed a dialysis session, or feeling very weak: contact your dialysis center today.
